lessons.title: Present perfect with for and since
lessons.description: Connecting past actions to the present, indicating duration (for) or starting point (since).
key_examples: I have lived here for five years.

exercises.explanation: Since is used with specific starting point in time.

lessons.title: Conditionals: First and Second Conditionals
lessons.description: Real future possibilities vs hypothetical/imaginary situations.
lessons.formula: 1st: If + present, will + V_inf | 2nd: If + past, would + V_inf
key_examples: If it rains, we will stay at home.
If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.

exercises.q: If I ___ you, I would take that job offer.
exercises.explanation: In 2nd conditional, 'were' is standard with all subjects.

lessons.title: Passive Voice in Academic Contexts
lessons.description: Shifting focus to the action or receiver; essential for IELTS Academic Task 1 & Task 2.
lessons.formula: S + be + past participle (+ by Agent)
key_examples: The data was gathered over a five-month period.
New safety protocols are being implemented.

exercises.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + V3.

lessons.title: Modal verbs of deduction and speculation
lessons.description: Must, can't, might, could to express degree of certainty in present and past.
lessons.formula: Modal + be / Modal + have + past participle
key_examples: She can't be at home; her car isn't outside.
They must have missed the morning train.

exercises.q: He's not answering his phone. He ___ (must / can't) be sleeping.
